use.flag: Install upstream's jottad.service systemd user unit. The OpenRC user-scope script in /etc/user/init.d is installed regardless of this flag.

pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Jottacloud CLI is the official command-line client for the Jottacloud cloud storage service. It has two parts: jottad, a per-user daemon that runs backups and two-way sync of local folders against a Jottacloud account, and jotta-cli, which logs in, adds or removes backup folders, configures sync, and browses, downloads and shares stored files by talking to that daemon.
The daemon runs in the user's session, with its data in ~/.jottad. This package installs an OpenRC user-scope service for it and, with USE=systemd, upstream's systemd user unit; upstream's run_jottad helper assumes systemd.
This package installs the prebuilt amd64 binaries from Jottacloud's own APT repository. They are statically linked Go executables with no library dependencies. No source code is published.
